title: Tiny Paper Origin
description: A small sized origin based on paper for the Origins mod.
body:
![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/850/672/tiny-paper-banner2.png) **DESCRIPTION** A very tiny origin based on paper. Lost in the vast lands, you are trying to put the pieces of paper together to find your true origin...  You will need the original [Origins](https://modrinth.com/mod/origins) and [Pehkui](https://modrinth.com/mod/pehkui) mods Your vanilla experience will be further enhanced thanks for the following features:-  \+ Sticker Using moisture in the air, you are able to stick to surfaces. \+ Paper Aeroplane You are able to fly through the air just like using an elytra. \+ Rock Paper Scissors Being like paper, you take no damage when you fall. \+ Aerodynamic Being so tiny and light, you can navigate more quickly. \+ Paper Bandage By equipping paper in your hotbar and using the Load Toolbar Activator key, you are able to apply a paper bandage to yourself. \+ Papercut Crafting paper gives you a stone sword with sharpness. \+ Starter Gear You start with 3x Sugar Canes and 5x Papers. \- Blown Away To avoid being blown away while you sleep, you can only sleep when your bed is deeper underground. \- Tiny Hearts You have 4 less heart than Humans giving you 6 hearts only. \- Water Exhaustion Being in contact with water causes you to exhaust more quickly.
